About.title: About & help
About.intro: {brand} connects anyone who needs crew for a boat with professionals who are available on those dates. How it works in practice follows.
About.clientTitle: If you are looking for crew
About.client1: You say what you need: role, dates, departure point and boat type.
About.client2: You see who is available for exactly those dates, with ratings, experience, languages and price.
About.client3: You send a request to one or several at once, and whoever replies first takes it.
About.client4: Once it is confirmed, you see their contact details and can coordinate within the app.
About.clientNote: The credit is reserved when you send the request and is charged only when a professional accepts it. If nobody accepts, or if you cancel while it is still open, it is released. If the professional cancels later, we look for a replacement at no extra charge; if none is found, the credit is refunded.
About.pro1: You create a profile with your role, licence, experience and price. Administration reviews it before it becomes visible.
About.pro2: You declare when you are available. You appear only in searches that match what you have declared.
About.pro3: You receive requests and reply. Accepting is binding and uses credits; the number is always shown next to the button, before you press it.
About.pro4: Replacements. When a colleague cancels, the position may be offered to you. You declare availability with no charge and no commitment; you are charged only if the client chooses you, and until then you can withdraw or take other work.
About.fees1: The platform runs on credits. A credit is used when a professional accepts the request: from the client, who reserved it when sending, and from the professional, on accepting. The number of credits is always shown before you press the button. Credits do not expire.
About.fees2: Payment for the work itself does not go through the platform: you agree on it and settle it directly between you. Details are in the terms of use.
About.trust1: Only those who actually worked together can review, after a completed booking. Both sides are reviewed, including the client.
About.trust2: Ranking is not for sale. No position in the results can be bought.
About.trust3: Phone numbers are not public. They are revealed only between the two sides, and only once the booking is confirmed.
About.help1: For a problem with a booking, a question about charges, a conduct report or your data, write to us through the <contact>contact form</contact>. The message goes directly to administration.
About.help2: See also the <termsPage>terms of use</termsPage> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
